# Third-Party Skills: Jeffallan/claude-skills

This directory contains a curated subset of third-party skills imported from:

- Repository: https://github.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills
- Branch: `main`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this folder)

## Why this subset is useful for CryptoTrackerBack

These selected skills are highly relevant to a Java/Spring backend codebase and day-to-day backend delivery:

- `spring-boot-engineer`: practical implementation patterns for Spring Boot services.
- `api-designer`: consistent REST/OpenAPI design guidance for stable contracts.
- `security-reviewer`: actionable security review workflows and report structure.
- `sre-engineer`: reliability practices (SLOs, incident response, automation).
- `test-master`: broad testing patterns across unit/integration/E2E/performance/security.

## Scope

Only this approved curated subset is included (not the full upstream repository).

For exact upstream paths and imported files, see `UPSTREAM.md`.
